name: Enterprise Issue Cards
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Keeps the stored token when a profile is saved with an empty token field.
Shows the empty-body message for blank bodies.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Saving a Pro server profile with an empty token field now keeps the token you stored for that server.
A ticket with no description text now says so, and blank lines in a description stay visible.
tip: A card keeps a local copy of the ticket. Select Refresh on the card to read the current copy from the server.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Enterprise Issue Cards is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it.
